summary: `awx-manage inventory_import` syncs a controller inventory with an inventory file, script or directory; create the destination inventory first and pass --inventory-id or --inventory-name plus --source.
questions: How do I import an inventory file with awx-manage?
Do I need to create the inventory before importing?

answer_card.title: Import inventory with awx-manage
answer_card.answer_md:
1. Create the destination inventory in controller.
2. As the `awx` user:
```bash
awx-manage inventory_import --source=/path/to/hosts --inventory-name="My Inventory"
# or --inventory-id=<id>
```
`--source` can be a file, dynamic script or directory.
